annotations.title: Daily fundamentals stock screen (about 1,850 US companies)

description: Use for a daily stock screen or to find candidates: rank by quality, growth, op_margin, fcf_margin, roe, net_cash, shrink (biggest share-count reduction), quarter_growth or revenue; filter by min revenue, growth, margins, quality, positive FCF, net cash, exchange; top 1-100. Each row: ticker, revenue, YoY and CAGR, latest-quarter growth, operating and FCF margin, ROE, net cash, share-count change, quality score. Data: SEC XBRL filings. PAID: $0.05 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/screen.

min_growth_pct.description: Minimum revenue CAGR (or YoY) in percent

min_revenue_usd.description: Minimum latest annual revenue in USD (default 1000000000)

net_cash.description: Only companies with more cash than long-term debt

positive_fcf.description: Only companies with positive free cash flow
